changes.title: Creature character
items: Creatures have character: each kind holds itself its own way (a proud stag, a low badger) and, standing about, does its own thing now and then: a wolf howls, a boar paws the ground, a squirrel flicks its tail, an otter shakes itself dry, a snake rises to look about
Happy creatures and your party animals give a little bounce of joy now and then

changes.title: Wave prefetch
items: A wave's angry creatures show their red eyes the moment their area wakes, not a few seconds later

changes.title: Champion bot
items: A new bot to watch: pick "champion" in the bedroom's Player menu (or ?bot=champion). It's the skilled bot being trained overnight to play better
